question: The _______ movement was led by Chaudhary Devi Lal in 1987.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nyay Yudh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chaudhary Devi Lal **led the **Nyaya Yudh** movement in **Haryana in1987.**
 
• It was a movement for seeking justice as the name says **Nyaya which means Justice.**
 
• He launched the Nyay Yudh movement by** forming a party known as Lok Dal**.
 
• He served as **chief minister of Haryana twice from 1977-79 and 1987-89**.
 
• He also served as the **6th deputy prime minister **of India from 1989 -1991 in the **governments of ‘Vishwanath Pratap Singh’ and ‘Chandra Shekhar Singh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chaudhary Devi Lal was born on 25 September 1914 in Teja Khera** village of Sirsa district in present-day Haryana
 
• **Chaudhary Devi Lal** was popularly known as **Tau**.
 
• He was a member of the Congress party but later he formed his party **Lok Dal and became the leader of the opposition.**
 
• **In his Assembly election campaign, he promised farmers to waive off their outstanding loans.**
 
• **Lok Dal alone secured 60 seats in the Assembly Election**, and along with its partners,** it secured 70 out of 90 seats in the State Assembly which made him Chief Minister of Haryana.**
